The '''Outer Rim Exploratory Mining Corps''', or '''OREMC''', also known simply as the '''Mining Corps''', was a front company used by undercover [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Tirsia Lek]], under the name of Zekra Fol, used the mining company as an undercover in order to arrest [[Marus Grayson]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] during the bidding of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
